verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a Data API that reads account, balance and transaction history via a single interface (truelayer-docs-5, truelayer-docs-28), but there is no evidence of pagination mechanics, documented history depth/lookback window, or an incremental sync pattern (e.g., delta/cursor endpoints) for fetching only changed transactions. missing for 10: pagination details, documented transaction history depth/limits, incremental/delta sync mechanism.
